scope: Diagnostic audit of all 44 current benchmark/backend winners; not a validation-policy or release-eligibility change.

winners.audit_observation: Prices the seven base contracts and expands homogeneous scaled copies on the GPU; not independent-option pricing throughput. Completion is synchronized; result download is outside the timer.
Prices seven base contracts before timing, then distributes GPU expansion of scaled copies. MPI maximum covers the completed expansion, not general option-price evaluation.
Caches invariant contract coefficients but retains per-option log/CDF pricing. Reviewed local partition, reduction and output assembly; actual 128-rank case passed.
Retains full per-option formula with vectorized CPU execution; odd option-count case passed. No additional workload omission identified.

Captures requested evolution steps in a CUDA graph before timing and executes the graph inside timing; odd noncubic case passed. Graph construction and final host copy are outside the device interval.
Reviewed slab ownership, neighbor exchange, two-stage update and corrected maximum-rank timing; odd noncubic evolution passed.
Reviewed periodic halos and communication-dependent evolution; odd noncubic case passed at both four and 128 ranks.
Size/cache-dependent fused path is absent from ordinary small validation. Both odd noncubic case and measured-size 512-cubed fused path with three steps passed.

Prepares a factorization CUDA graph before timing; actual factorization and graph transfers execute inside timing. Full reconstruction internal check shares arithmetic machinery with input creation, so it is not a fully independent oracle.
Uses shared-memory MPI windows on the one-node system; reviewed factorization and corrected maximum-rank interval. Odd matrix size and residual/external comparisons passed.
Uses shared-memory MPI factorization rather than a general inter-node solver. Odd matrix size passed at four and 128 ranks with unchanged residual and external checks.
Tile size changes from 48 to 96 above n=1536. Both n=513 remainder case and n=1537 larger-tile path passed.
Computes distances but drops the unobserved predecessor/path matrix. Remainder case passed; the sparse integer external oracle remains weak.
Uses lossless bounded-distance encoding and shared-memory work; retains path updates. Remainder case passed. Output/path assembly placement follows the existing reviewed timing contract.
Drops unobserved path updates while computing distances. Remainder case passed at four and 128 ranks; fixed sparse output samples cannot certify the full distance matrix.
Retains distance and path updates with blocked CPU work. Remainder case passed; shares the same sparse distance-only external oracle.
Reviewed tiled full dot products, edge guards and completion; n=513 passed. Internal spot checks and external summaries are not full independent matrix comparison.

Untimed CPU/GPU trials choose the split, then the full timed product is recomputed. Shared windows and explicit affinity widening specialize local execution; no extra physical-core use was established.
Creates deterministic A rows and B columns locally before timing, avoiding timed panel exchange. Full dot products retained; odd size passed at four and 128 ranks.
Reviewed packing, tile tails and full product computation. Odd matrix size passed; no additional workload omission identified.
Reviewed full pairwise force work, requested time-step loop, tail handling and device completion. Odd body and step counts passed.
Reviewed force partition, position exchange and time-step loop. Affinity helper can widen the launcher mask; the explicit OMP thread count remains honored. No resource overuse demonstrated.
Reviewed distributed force work and per-step position exchange. Odd body and step counts passed at four and 128 ranks.
Reviewed pairwise force reduction and requested step count; odd body and step counts passed. Printed energy is diagnostic, not a conservation gate.

Prunes distances/candidates instead of materializing every pair; reduced-precision filtering has double-precision fallback. Nondefault threshold and odd point count passed; this is not proof for every threshold.
Reviewed greedy candidate selection, member maintenance and the corrected interval including required preprocessing. Nondefault threshold and odd point count passed.
Prunes candidate work while retaining greedy selection/communication. Nondefault threshold and odd point count passed at four and 128 ranks.
Uses candidate/member reuse and neighbor pruning; no requirement to materialize a quadratic distance matrix. Nondefault threshold and odd point count passed.

Retains visibility traversal and sequential random stream via jump-ahead; reviewed pair generation, propagation and correlation. Changed scene/time/source/reflectivity case passed existing coarse distance checks.

Convex-icosphere specialization removes octree visibility traversal; replaces the original random stream with counter-based hash samples. Keeps 16 samples per pair and propagation. Passed existing coarse distance checks, not sample-by-sample semantic equivalence.
Retains visibility traversal and sequential random stream via jump-ahead; reviewed distributed work and corrected interval. Changed scene/time/source/reflectivity case passed at four and 128 ranks.

Computes each unordered pair once and mirrors the Monte Carlo estimate. Reciprocity permits the physical symmetry, but sampling correlation differs from independent ordered-pair estimates. Existing coarse distance checks passed.
Persistent kernel explicitly loops over all requested repetitions of immutable A times x; odd-size case passed. Final output alone cannot verify the repetition count.
CUDA graphs batch 64 iterations with explicit tail handling. Both odd-size case and 67-iteration graph-plus-tail case passed; output alone cannot verify repetitions.
Explicit requested iteration loop retains repeated local SpMV. Odd-size case passed at four and 128 ranks; final output alone cannot verify repetitions.
Persistent team repeats row products using fixed static ownership and nowait; no cross-row dependency. Odd-size case passed; final output alone cannot verify repetitions.
Reviewed boundary handling, step count, ping-pong parity and device completion. Odd noncubic case passed; cubic fixed samples miss the evolving interior.
Reviewed shared-memory slab communication, boundaries, parity and corrected timing. Odd noncubic case passed; validation summaries are not full-grid equality.
Reviewed halo exchange, boundaries and step parity. Odd noncubic case passed at four and 128 ranks; standard cubic samples all lie on fixed boundaries.
Measured-size working set selects non-temporal stores absent from standard validation. Odd noncubic case and 512-cubed streaming path with three steps passed.
Replaces generic adjacency traversal with arithmetic neighbors of the regular generated grid. Boundary-sensitive odd-grid long-evolution case passed; not general unstructured-mesh throughput.
Specializes regular-grid neighbors and retains distributed halo-dependent evolution. Long-evolution odd-grid case passed in addition to the established boundary supplement.
Specializes regular-grid neighbors. Long-evolution odd-grid case passed at four and 128 ranks; existing boundary-validation supplement remains required.
Retains compact adjacency traversal and flux computation rather than replacing connectivity with grid arithmetic. Long-evolution odd-grid case passed.
